title: Discard one cached scope
responsibility: Attempts to remove a cached lookup and the projection it names.

inputs.name: projectionCacheDiscard.directory
inputs.description: The directory containing the cached lookup and projection files.

inputs.name: projectionCacheDiscard.scope
inputs.description: The exact scope string whose hash selects the lookup.

outputs.name: projectionCacheDiscard
outputs.description: A promise completing after attempts to remove the lookup and, when its identity can be read, its named projection. Missing, unreadable or malformed lookup files and unlink failures are swallowed; completion does not prove every file was removed.
